headline: Frontlines Surge as Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Stonecradle Ignite
war_summary: Since the 18:10 edition the conflict has intensified on a handful of sectors. Weathered Expanse now logs ten ownership changes in the last two hours and sixty‑eight in the past day, with colonial and warden casualties both accelerating to roughly 1,230 and 1,350 per hour while fresh enlistments climb sharply. Stlican Shelf adds three flips in two hours and fifty‑five daily; casualties are accelerating on both sides (≈360 colonial, 450 warden per hour) and enlistments rise. Stonecradle records nine flips in two hours and twenty daily, with casualties surging (≈1,190 colonial, 1,150 warden per hour) and enlistments accelerating. Linn Mercy shows two recent flips and eighteen daily; casualties have cooled on the one‑hour window but enlistments are picking up. Callahan’s Passage remains a bloodbath with fifteen daily flips, massive and accelerating casualties (≈865 colonial, 488 warden per hour) and a surge of new troops. Farranac Coast posts three flips in six hours and six daily, with casualties still high and accelerating on the one‑hour window. The remaining regions stay largely static with negligible events and low, stable casualties.
